title: Saigon sights & cool places
sub: Landmarks, hidden history and legendary eats, Nov 2026

home.name: Wink Hotel Saigon Centre
home.addr: 75 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Đa Kao, District 1

places.name: Thích Quảng Đức Monument
notes: Memorial on the exact corner where the monk burned himself in protest in June 1963
The 'Burning Monk' photo shocked the world; the statue shows him wreathed in flames
Free, open-air, on a busy junction: 10 min is plenty
places.addr: Cách Mạng Tháng Tám × Nguyễn Đình Chiểu, District 3

places.name: Cà Phê Đỗ Phủ (war-time commando café)
notes: Looks like any shopfront, but was a base for Saigon's commando network in the war against the US
Hidden letterboxes, a bunker and an escape route are still there; open to visitors since 2017
Also does cơm tấm (broken rice) downstairs
Pin is approximate (Tân Định, near the market); Directions finds 113A Đặng Dung

places.name: Bánh Xèo 46A (crispy Saigon pancakes since 1945)
notes: Legendary bánh xèo joint, Michelin-listed: huge crispy turmeric pancakes with prawn and pork
Wrap pieces in lettuce and herbs, dip in fish sauce
Round the corner from the pink church; about 15 min walk from Wink
places.addr: 46A Đinh Công Tráng, Tân Định, District 1
